The test image clearly shows the tassel being replaced by a large, bushy mass of small leafy structures - this is the hallmark symptom of Crazy_top. The Crazy_top reference images confirm this pattern.

My initial prediction is **Crazy_top**.

Now let me check the attractor guide.

Crazy_top is listed as over-predicted (5x wrong). The alternatives are Maize_chlorotic_dwarf_virus, Downy_mildew, Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma, and Stewarts_wilt. However, I already viewed Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma (shows stunted plants with reddish/brown leaves - completely different). The other alternatives are leaf-symptom diseases that would not produce this tassel replacement. The test image unambiguously shows a bushy mass of small leaves replacing the tassel, which is the hallmark diagnostic feature of Crazy_top.

This matches both the symptom description and reference images perfectly. Alternatives from the attractor guide (viral diseases, Downy_mildew) produce leaf symptoms not tassel replacement."}
